cases.source:
have fn r48_conditional_probability(joint, evidence R: evidence > 0) R = joint / evidence

have fn r48_bayes_posterior(prior, likelihood, evidence R: evidence > 0) R = likelihood * prior / evidence

thm r48_bayes_rule:
    ? forall prior, likelihood, evidence, joint R:
        evidence > 0
        joint = likelihood * prior
        =>:
            r48_conditional_probability(joint, evidence) = r48_bayes_posterior(prior, likelihood, evidence)
    r48_conditional_probability(joint, evidence) = joint / evidence
    r48_bayes_posterior(prior, likelihood, evidence) = likelihood * prior / evidence
    joint / evidence = likelihood * prior / evidence
